shared_elements: animal shown with head and forelimbs/claws
relief carving on a flat upright surface
justification: Both surfaces depict an animal figure in relief with a raptor-like head and visible clawed limbs, which is the most specific shared trait, and both place the creature on a vertical panel. But A shows a detailed, finely incised anthropomorphic winged figure in strict profile, with human body, elaborate garment, bracelets, a handled bucket and a stylised flowering tree filling the field, while B shows a squat, plain, high-relief quadruped/creature descending head-down beside a small schematic incised animal, with no attributes, no garment, no vegetal motif and utterly different proportions and surface conventions.
